exposure: additional midwifery tasks and clinical protocols
outcome: midwives' and healthcare assistants' perspectives on changes and challenges in postnatal care
impact on maternal health due to limited community follow-up
cohort: Fifteen midwives and healthcare assistants from an Irish urban maternity hospital participated in two focus groups.
finding: Midwives and healthcare assistants perceive that increased maternal comorbidities, higher caesarean section rates, additional midwifery tasks, and shorter hospital stays negatively impact high-quality, woman-centred postnatal care, highlighting the need for additional community midwifery support.
mod_finding: Increased caesarean section rates were identified as creating additional postnatal care needs.
